[[File:Rergo_IV_power_condenser.jpg|thumb|right|A Rergo IV power condenser]]
A '''Rergo IV power condenser''' was a common tool found in [[computer tool kit]]s. Used in conjunction with a [[HiBaka 2000 mem-stik]], it could be used to smuggle data in the hollowed out handle of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] by connecting it to the blaster's [[apas connector]]s and the mem-stik.
